question: Our flight was 6 hours late because of fog at the airport. What do I get?
draft: Sorry about that. Since the delay was within our control and you arrived 6 hours late, you are entitled to $250 in compensation.
note: Fog is weather: DLY-004, no compensation.

question: We sat on the tarmac because of an air traffic control restriction and arrived 4 hours late.
draft: You arrived 4 hours late because of a delay within our control, so you are entitled to $125.
note: Air traffic control is outside the airline's control (DLY-004).

question: My flight was 3 hours late. What compensation can I get?
draft: Since you arrived 9 hours late, you are entitled to $400 in compensation.
note: The customer said 3 hours; the draft uses the 9-hour tier.

question: A security alert at the airport delayed us by 8 hours.
draft: As this delay was caused by us and you were delayed by 8 hours, we will pay you $250.
note: Security events are outside the airline's control (DLY-004).

question: I opened my checking account last year and I'm closing it now. Any fee?
draft: Since you're closing within 90 days of opening, an early closure fee of $25 applies.
note: CLS-001 v1 charges only within 90 days of opening; this account is older.

question: I've already had two overdraft fees refunded this year. Can I get another courtesy refund?
draft: Since this would be your first courtesy refund this year, you can ask for one within 60 days of the date the fee was charged.
note: FRV-001 v2 allows two in any 12-month period; the customer has had two.

question: I'm flying in Business class to my father's funeral. Can I get the bereavement fare?
draft: Since you're travelling in Economy, the bereavement fare applies, and it is 40% off the lowest available Economy fare.
note: The customer flies Business, which BRV-005 excludes.

question: My flight was 3 hours late because of a thunderstorm. Do I get compensation?
draft: I'm sorry for the wait. Because the delay was caused by weather, it is outside our control and not eligible for compensation, but meal vouchers are provided for delays of 3 hours or more.

question: Our flight landed 9 hours late because the airline had no crew available.
draft: I'm very sorry. Since a crew shortage is within our control and you arrived 9 hours late, you are entitled to $400 in compensation.

question: I opened my account three weeks ago and I want to close it. Is there a fee?
draft: No. Even though your account is only three weeks old, there is no fee to close an account, however soon after opening it is closed.

question: I paid for a coffee in euros with my debit card. Is there a fee?
draft: Yes. Because the purchase was in a currency other than US dollars, a foreign transaction fee of 3% of the amount applies.

question: Aurelia Air cancelled my flight, and I'd like my money back. My ticket was non-refundable.
draft: Since we cancelled your flight, you can get a full refund of the unused portion of your ticket, even though it was non-refundable.
